# James Kenneth Guidaven

> Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across the full stack, strongest on the frontend. Works closely with product designers, turning Figma specs into fast, production-ready UIs in React, Angular, or Vue. Strong engineering fundamentals, amplified by AI. Leads projects end to end, including AI work. Fully remote from Cebu, Philippines (UTC+8).

## Summary

- Builds web products end to end: user interfaces, APIs, and the systems behind them.
- Strongest: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex. Also shipped with PHP, MCP servers, Node.js, Java / Spring Boot, AWS, Angular, Vue, React Native.
- AI engineering: MCP servers, agent tooling, context engineering, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex. Sets up codebases so agents produce reliable code, and a person reviews every change.
- Engineering fundamentals: software architecture, design patterns and SOLID, web security (OAuth 2.0 / 2.1, JWT, Secure Development Lifecycle), testing across the lifecycle, data structures and algorithms.
- 4+ years fully remote and async.

## Experience

- Current role (2022 – present): Senior Software Engineer at a global, fully remote software company. Led the build of an MCP server that connects a customer dashboard to AI assistants; built Claude Code skills and AI workflows for the team; built shared layout foundations and multi-user support; shipped self-serve support features.
- 2019 – 2022: Senior Software Engineer. Mobile apps and serverless AWS services for an open-source digital identity toolkit.
- 2018 – 2019: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer. Marketplace integrations (BigCommerce, WooCommerce, eBay, Amazon, ShipStation) for an inventory and order management app.
- 2015 – 2018: Software Engineer. Primary contributor to an enterprise admin portal's architecture; introduced a Secure Development Lifecycle; added JWT to the identity service.
- 2014 – 2015: Lead Software Engineer & Co-Founder of a small software company. Introduced Agile; led an ERP build and an SMS / email broadcasting platform.
- 2011 – 2014: Software Engineer. Retail self-checkout customizations in C/C++ and developer tools that sped up debugging.
- Education: BS Information Technology, University of Cebu. 1st place, thesis competition at the Battle of IT Schools (BITS).

## Open source and side projects

- [Linear Issue Enricher](https://github.com/jkguidaven/linear-issue-enricher): Claude Code plugin, built as a team tool and then open-sourced, that scores Linear issues for agent-readiness and writes agent-ready specs.
- [HealthOS](https://jkguidaven.github.io/healthos/): local-first health and fitness app (React Native, Expo, Gemini AI, SQLite).
- [Tessera UI](https://jkguidaven.github.io/tessera-ui/): 71 accessible Web Components for React, Vue, Angular, and plain HTML.
- [DSA Visualizer](https://jkguidaven.github.io/dsa-visualizer): animates sorting, pathfinding, and graph algorithms.
